book.bonded.field_guide.name: Bonded Field Guide
book.bonded.field_guide.description: Equipment remembers what you do with it. Use this guide to learn how Bond grows, how the benches work, and which unusual habits can awaken an augment.
book.bonded.field_guide.bonding.name: Bonding
book.bonded.field_guide.bonding.descript: How equipment learns from being used and cared for.

book.bonded.field_guide.augments.name: Augments
book.bonded.field_guide.augments.descrip: Rare behaviors awakened by doing something memorable with a particular item.
book.bonded.field_guide.bonding.getting_: How gear earns Bond and improves through use.

Tools, weapons, armor, shields, bows, fishing rods, and other useful equipment gain **Bond** as you use them. The useful action depends on the item: mine with a pickaxe, fight with a weapon, block with a shield, or wear armor while it protects you.

Bond belongs to the individual item. As its level rises, the item can gain ordinary improvements such as durability or damage. Its tooltip records its current level, experience, bonuses, and augment progress.
book.bonded.field_guide.bonding.upgradin: Upgrade and repair equipment without replacing it.
When equipment reaches its maximum level, use it on a Tool Bench with the material shown by the bench. The item keeps its identity while moving to its next material tier.

Use damaged equipment on a Repair Bench with a matching repair material or Scrap. Excess repair can become temporary over-repair instead of being wasted. Nearby containers can supply materials to either bench.
book.bonded.field_guide.recipes.workstat: Craft the Tool Bench and Repair Bench.
book.bonded.field_guide.recipes.tempered: Upgrade gold gear and recover a sturdier material.
Gold equipment that reaches its maximum level can be upgraded into Tempered Gold at a Tool Bench. Tempered Gold Nuggets can also be recovered while mining Nether Gold Ore with the right tool.
book.bonded.field_guide.augments.about.d: Train unusual behaviors on one particular item.
book.bonded.field_guide.augments.about.t: Some equipment remembers more than ordinary use. Repeating an unusual, fitting action with one particular item trains an **augment**. Its progress is separate from Bond levels and belongs to that item alone.
book.bonded.field_guide.augments.about.a: An augment awakens when its training is complete. Each one changes behavior rather than merely adding another level bonus. Inspect the item's tooltip to see what it has begun learning.
book.bonded.field_guide.augments.cake_de: Break cakes with one item to train a sweet surprise.
A melee weapon or mining tool begins training Cake Destroyer when it breaks cakes, including cakes with candles. Break 100 cakes with the same item to awaken it.
Once active, direct melee hits dealing more than two damage have a small chance to shake sugar loose from the target. Sensible? No. Memorable? Absolutely.
book.bonded.field_guide.augments.oceanic: Train leggings underwater to move more freely while swimming.
Leggings train Oceanic while their wearer spends time underwater. Keep the same pair beneath the surface until its augment progress reaches 7,500.
Once active, the leggings improve movement efficiency whenever their wearer is swimming. Water stops pushing back so stubbornly.
